    Particle Physics Beyond the Standard Model

    Graduate Course, University of Iowa, Department of Physics and Astronomy, 2025

    Fall 2025: Particle Physics Beyond the Standard Model

    PHYS:5905:0042 Special Topics in Physics: Syllabus / Additional reading

    Introduction and overview:

    • Natural units and waves
    • A crash course on the Standard Model
    • Spin, helicity, and neutrinos
    • A taste of perturbation theory and observables
    • Phase space and naive dimensional analysis

    Neutrino physics:

    • Neutrino oscillations
    • Neutrino oscillations beyond plane waves
    • Neutrino oscillations in matter and the MSW effect
    • The cosmic neutrino background (discussion and solution)
    • Proton decay (discussion and solution)
    • Oscillations with non-hermitian evolution (discussion and solution)
    • Matter effects (discussion and solution)
    • Short-baseline oscillations
    • Seesaw mechanism
    • More heavy neutrinos (discussion and solution)

    Dark matter:

    • FLRW geometry
    • Universe expansion (discussion and solution)
    • Thermal dark matter (discussion and solution)
